title: 让步与比较状语从句

examples.en: Though he is young, he knows a lot.
examples.zh: 虽然他年纪小，但懂得很多。

examples.en: He runs faster than I do.

guess.question: “虽然他很累，但他继续工作”能说 Though he was tired, but he kept working. 吗？

options.text: 不行——though 和 but 不能同时用，跟 because 和 so 一个道理
options.feedback: 对！英语里“虽然”和“但是”也只能留一个。

options.text: 可以，两个一起用更清楚
options.feedback: 不对——同时用是错的，属于典型的中式英语。

options.text: 两个都不能用，要用 however
options.feedback: 不对——though 或 but 单独用哪个都对，只是不能同时出现。

rule.rule: though / although 引导让步状语从句，不能与 but 连用（可与 yet / still 连用）；比较状语从句用 than 或 as … as，as…as 中间用原级
rule.formula: ① Though / Although + 从句，主句（不加 but）　② 比较级 + than：He runs faster than I do.　③ as + 原级 + as：He is as tall as me.　④ 否定：not as / so + 原级 + as

anchors.en: Although it rained hard, they went on working.
anchors.zh: 虽然雨下得很大，他们还是继续工作。
anchors.note: although 不与 but 连用

anchors.en: He didn't run so fast as his brother.

trap.wrong: Though he is young, but he knows a lot.
trap.right: Though he is young, he knows a lot. / He is young, but he knows a lot.

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——though / although 不配 but；比较用 than，同级用 as…as（中间放原级）。

check.stem: ____ he is only ten years old, he can speak three languages.

options.distractor: but 不能引导从句放在句首这样用
前后不是因果结果关系

check.stem: He didn't run ____ fast ____ his brother.

options.distractor: so 不与 than 搭配

check.explanation: not so + 原级 + as（不如……）。
